about: Usage counts: everything Bridge AI can count and send, if you turn on Share anonymous usage counts (off unless you do). server/counts.js counts only the names here, and a test fails if the code counts any other. Adding one is a change to this file, in public.
endpointAbout: Where a week's report goes (HTTPS POST, JSON). Empty: the project has no server for it yet, so sharing isn't offered.

report.install: desktop (the app), source (a clone) or docker
report.installAge: how long Bridge AI has been on this computer: week 1, 2-4 weeks, 5-12 weeks or 13+ weeks
report.daysActive: on how many days of the week something was counted, 0 to 7
report.counts: each counter below that isn't 0, as a bucket
report.nonce: random, new for each report, so a report sent twice is counted once; it says nothing about you or this computer

counters.agents.peak: The most agents running at once
counters.agents.ownBranch: Agents started on a branch of their own (a worktree)
counters.agents.compared: The same first message sent to a second kind of agent
counters.prs.opened: Pull requests opened from Bridge AI
counters.chief.tasks: Tasks added to Chief of Staff's list
counters.voice.transcribed: Times speech was turned into text (voice notes and dictation)
counters.setup.simple: Setup finished with the simple layout
counters.errors.window: Times a part of the window broke and showed its error
